signals.title: Codex reserves asynchronous user progress messaging for root agents while excluding subagents
signals.title_zh: Codex 将异步用户进度消息保留给 Root Agent，并继续排除 Subagent
signals.summary: Codex added a disabled-by-default feature flag that can expose send_message_to_user_async to root agents even without model-catalog support, while integration tests explicitly keep the tool unavailable to subagents under catalog opt-in, feature opt-in, or both. The tool can emit user-visible progress without ending the turn.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 新增默认关闭的 Feature Flag，使 Root Agent 即使没有 Model Catalog 支持也可获得 send_message_to_user_async；集成测试则明确保证无论 Catalog Opt-in、Feature Opt-in 或两者同时启用，Subagent 都拿不到该工具。该工具可在不结束当前 Turn 的情况下发送用户可见进度。

researchValue.failure: If every subagent can independently message the human, internal worker activity can bypass the manager boundary and fragment responsibility, status and interruption semantics.
researchValue.finding: The merged implementation keeps asynchronous user messaging at the root-agent boundary even when the feature is enabled through multiple opt-in paths.
researchValue.mechanism: Gate the progress-message tool on root session identity plus explicit feature/catalog opt-in, and let it emit a user-facing item without terminating the active turn.
researchValue.implication: A multi-agent runtime can make human-facing communication a role-scoped capability rather than a generic tool inherited by every worker.

signals.title: Google ADK runs after-agent cleanup on cancellation without converting cancellation into ordinary completion
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 在取消路径执行 After-Agent 清理，同时不把取消伪装成普通完成
signals.summary: Google ADK now catches asyncio.CancelledError after the before-agent callback has completed and, when appropriate, runs after_agent_callback for cleanup side effects such as metrics and timers before re-raising the original cancellation. It deliberately does not run the callback when cancellation occurs during before-agent setup, when end_invocation short-circuits, or after it already ran; cleanup exceptions are logged rather than masking cancellation.
signals.summary_zh: Google ADK 现在会在 Before-Agent Callback 已完成后捕获 asyncio.CancelledError，并在适用条件下执行 after_agent_callback，以清理 Metrics、Timer 等副作用，然后重新抛出原始取消。若取消发生在 Before-Agent 阶段、end_invocation 已短路或 After Callback 已执行，则不会重复调用；清理异常只记录日志，不覆盖原始取消。

researchValue.failure: Cancellation can bypass lifecycle-finalization hooks and leak timers, metrics or plugin-side state even though the worker has stopped.
researchValue.finding: The fix separates cancellation cleanup from successful completion and preserves the original cancellation as the authoritative terminal control signal.
researchValue.mechanism: Track whether setup and after-callback phases actually ran, execute cleanup once on the cancellation path, suppress secondary cleanup errors, and then re-raise cancellation.
researchValue.implication: Agent runtimes need explicit cancellation semantics: cleanup obligations may survive cancellation even when business completion must not.

signals.title: Google ADK makes parallel list-state merge semantics explicit: concatenate to avoid loss, but duplicates remain a modeling problem
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 显式化并行 List State 合并：用拼接避免丢失，但重复项仍是建模问题
signals.summary: Google ADK changed deep_merge_dicts so list-valued state deltas from parallel tool responses are concatenated instead of silently overwriting earlier list entries. The implementation explicitly does not deduplicate: parallel tools that write full lists can duplicate existing elements, and callers needing set or keyed semantics are advised to model state deltas as dictionaries.
signals.summary_zh: Google ADK 修改 deep_merge_dicts，使并行 Tool Response 的 List 类型 State Delta 采用拼接而不是让后写结果静默覆盖先写内容。实现明确不做去重：若并行工具写入完整列表，可能重复已有元素；需要 Set 或 Keyed 语义时应改用 Dict 建模。

researchValue.failure: Parallel tool calls can each produce valid state deltas yet a generic last-writer-wins merge silently drops one branch's list entries.
researchValue.finding: Concatenation prevents silent loss but does not solve semantic conflicts or duplicate effects.
researchValue.mechanism: Define merge behavior by state type and require callers to use keyed structures when uniqueness or conflict resolution matters.
researchValue.implication: Concurrent agent state needs an explicit merge contract; preventing data loss is only the first layer, not a complete concurrency policy.

signals.title: Anthropic's incident review shows a completed agentic audit search can still miss the evidence set it was meant to find
signals.title_zh: Anthropic 事故复盘显示：Agentic 审计搜索“完成”仍可能漏掉本应发现的证据
signals.summary: Anthropic reports that an initial scan of roughly 141,000 transcripts used an agentic search to identify cyber-evaluation sessions with possible internet access, but that search missed a set of relevant transcripts. A later review found a fourth incident, after which Anthropic broadened the search to roughly 481 million transcripts across red-team, non-cyber evaluation, RL and subagent logs.
signals.summary_zh: Anthropic 报告称，最初约 14.1 万份 Transcript 的扫描使用 Agentic Search 来识别可能获得互联网访问的网络安全评测会话，但这次搜索漏掉了一组相关记录。后续复查发现第 4 起事故后，Anthropic 将范围扩大到约 4.81 亿份 Transcript，覆盖红队、非网络安全评测、RL 环境和 Subagent Logs 等。

researchValue.failure: An AI-assisted audit can finish its search procedure while still failing the business claim that all relevant evidence was found.
researchValue.finding: The disclosed incident set changed after expanding the evidence universe and revisiting transcripts the earlier agentic search missed.
researchValue.mechanism: Separate search-process completion from coverage proof, preserve a larger evidence inventory, and use independent follow-up passes when missed-case cost is high.
researchValue.implication: Agent-run audits should report observable coverage and blind spots explicitly; 'search completed' is not equivalent to 'audit complete'.

signals.title: AgentRewind aligns agent-context and environment checkpoints so long-horizon recovery can roll back both sides together
signals.title_zh: AgentRewind 对齐 Agent Context 与环境 Checkpoint，让长周期恢复能同时回滚两侧状态
signals.summary: AgentRewind targets errors that propagate through both model context and environment state during long-horizon agent work. It records aligned checkpoints of the agent context and a controlled environment, allowing recovery to an earlier joint state and resumption with information from previous attempts; the accompanying MettleBench evaluates task completion and partial progress on long-horizon engineering assignments.
signals.summary_zh: AgentRewind 面向长周期 Agent 工作中同时污染模型 Context 与 Environment State 的错误，记录二者对齐的 Checkpoint，使系统可以回到更早的联合状态，并携带前次尝试的信息继续执行；配套 MettleBench 用长周期工程任务评估任务完成度与部分进度。

researchValue.failure: Rolling back only model context or only environment state can leave a recovered agent inconsistent with the world it is resuming against.
researchValue.finding: The reported experiments show aligned recovery improves task success and checklist progress across tasks, models, execution strategies and harnesses relative to compared baselines.
researchValue.mechanism: Capture synchronized checkpoints of reasoning context and controlled environment, then resume from an earlier joint state while retaining information from failed attempts.
researchValue.implication: Long-running digital employees need recovery boundaries that bind cognitive state and effect state together rather than treating chat history as the only resumable state.
